Kansas Corporation Commission
                                 Commission Meeting
                            September 29, 2026 @ 10:00 am
                  KCC Offices, 1500 SW Arrowhead Rd., Topeka, Kansas

                                          MINUTES

The Commission convened the regularly scheduled open meeting of the Commission at 10:00 am
on September 29, 2026, at the Kansas Corporation Commission, 1500 SW Arrowhead Road,
Topeka, Kansas.

Present: Chairperson French, Commissioner Keen, Commissioner Kuether, Assistant General
Counsel Aaron Bailey, and Litigation Counsel Ahsan Latif. The following were considered by
the Commission:
     1.   Consent Agenda: Commissioner Keen moved for approval of the Consent Agenda
          dated September 29, 2026. The Consent Agenda contains pages one through six and
          is attached to the Minutes. Commissioner Kuether seconded the motion.

          The motion was approved.

     2.   Noticed Items:
           A. Docket No. 27-EKME-0157-COM
               In the Matter of the Complaint Against Evergy by Joon W. Kim
               O-005622 - Order Making Prima Facie Determination
               Commissioner Keen moved to approve the Order. Commissioner Kuether
               seconded the motion.
               The order was approved.

           B. Docket No. 27-TRAM-0160-PEN
              In the Matter of the Investigation of Ernesto Reyes d/b/a 503 Express, of
              Garden City, Kansas. Regarding the Violation(s) of the Motor Carrier Safety
              Statutes, Rules and Regulations and the Commission's Authority to Impose
              Penalties, Sanctions and/or the Revocation of Motor Carrier Authority.
               O-005608 - Penalty Order
               Commissioner Keen moved to approve the Order. Commissioner Kuether
               seconded the motion.
               The order was approved.




                                          Page 1 of 2
     There being no further matters before the Commission, Commissioner Kuether moved for
    adjournment of the Commission meeting. Commissioner Keen seconded the motion. The
    Commission adjourned the September 29, 2026, Commission Meeting at 10:05 am.




                                                              Andrew J. French, Chair




                                                              Dwight D. Keen, Commissioner




Attest:


          Jesse R. Becker, Executive Director                 Annie Kuether, Commissioner

NOTICE TO THE PUBLIC: There will be no separate discussion of Consent Agenda items as they are
considered to be routine by the Kansas Corporation Commission. Unless removed from the website's Consent
Agenda, the orders appearing on the Consent Agenda will become the Order of the full Commission at the
Commission’s regularly scheduled Business Meeting. If Commission staff or a Commissioner requests an item
be removed from the Consent Agenda, the affected item may be considered separately or placed on the earliest
possible Business Meeting agenda for discussion.
